title: LinkedIn used for customer complaints over support
discussion_signal: The post describes LinkedIn being used to chase refunds, escalate support tickets, tag executives, and publicly document bad service. It asks whether public posting is filling a gap left by ordinary support channels.
linked_research_question: Whether a formal complaint route becomes a public reputation or escalation route when a consumer cannot obtain a usable remedy through ordinary support.
limits: Single LinkedIn author and selected audience
Post describes a pattern but does not measure how common it is
No underlying complaint records or resolution outcomes are verified
